text:
marta: Hey team, getting a flood of 5xxs from the hosted inference gateway starting ~09:07 UTC. P95 token latency jumped to 2.3s and overall error rate ~6%. Looks correlated with cache errors in the logs. @ben @raj can you take a look? :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-3107 (link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2025-3107) — severity: high.

ben: I see the same in the edge metrics. Gateway 502/504s originating from route /v1/generate, upstream upstream-hosted-infer-01 returning 502. Any backend traces?

marta: Pasted the redis/memcached errors we got from the model-proxy pods:

```
[2025-06-04T09:07:12Z] cache.prefix.lookup failed: ERR maxmemory on node redis-cluster-2
[2025-06-04T09:07:13Z] cache.evicted_keys=124538 rate spike
[2025-06-04T09:07:13Z] kv-prefetch: redis slab rebalancer triggered, latency 800ms
[2025-06-04T09:07:15Z] gateway->model-proxy: downstream read timeout after 30s
```

marta: Also seeing repeated `LOADING` and `OOM` lines in redis logs for a subset of shards.

emma: Is this the new autoscale policy change from last night? We rolled a node group update for the redis cluster at 03:40 UTC. Could be slab rebalancer + new memory profile.

raj: Looks like slab rebalancer + eviction storm -> mass cache misses -> model-proxy saturates and times out to the model runtime, then gateway 502s. Quick mitigations: 1) disable prefix caching for affected routes 2) bump redis memory/slab config or pin shards 3) divert traffic to replica pool.

luis: Repro snippet for a failing request (from curl):

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-request-id: 7f9a2b
```

ben: Rolling a quick mitigation: increasing redis maxmemory-policy to allkeys-lru temporarily and kicked an extra node into the cluster to offload slabs. Also toggled cache bypass on /v1/generate so model-proxy will fetch directly for warm requests.

marta: After bypassing cache for the hot routes the 5xx rate dropped from 6% to ~0.6% in 7 minutes. P95 latency came down to ~450ms.

ops-bot: INC-2025-3107 status changed to "mitigated" by ben.

raj: Next steps for RCA: collect redis eviction histograms, slab rebalancer logs, the autoscaler change diff from last night, and model-proxy KV/cache metrics. Also need to check whether the memcached fallback pool was healthy — there were failover logs hitting the DB which increased latency.

emma: Action items:
- emma: open infra-redis ticket to freeze autoscaler changes and apply conservative shard pinning (ETA 2h)
- ben: run postmortem and add a throttling layer for cache rewarm to avoid fanout (ETA today)
- marta: follow up with the customer-facing support thread and flag affected orgs for credits (ETA 1h)

luis: FYI, I captured heap/eviction counters: evictions spiked to 120k/min and replication lag briefly hit 6s on redis-cluster-2.

marta: I'm going to add logs and the repro curl to the incident page. Assigning to eng-infra for cluster config rollback if needed.

ben: Also adding a temporary rate limit on high-QPS customers for the affected route to reduce thundering rewarms.

ops-bot: INC-2025-3107 updated: mitigations applied, RCA in progress.

marta: thanks all — will post a short summary in #support after RCA. :thumbsup:
